title: Ligusticum chuanxiong Hort. Targets hsa-miR-10a-5p to Potentially Induce Apoptosis and Modulate Lipid Metabolism in Glioblastoma: A Natural-Product-Based Therapeutic Strategy.
authors: Cai, Xiao-Xuan; Zuo, Hua-Li; Li, Jing; Huang, Hsi-Yuan; Li, Li-Ping; Ni, Jie; Wu, Pei-Sen; Xu, Xiao-Yuan; Zhang, Dan; Xie, Yue-Yang; Huang, Hsien-Da; Lin, Yang-Chi-Dung
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药川芎成分通过miRNA调控胶质母细胞瘤凋亡与脂代谢，虽涉及E2F1与miR-29a启动子结合的EMSA验证及分子对接，但核心是miRNA-靶基因网络与药物机制，非TF-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Background/Objectives: Glioblastoma (GBM), the most aggressive primary malignant brain tumor, has a dismal prognosis and limited treatment options. The dried rhizome of Ligusticum chuanxiong Hort. (Chuanxiong, CX) is a traditional Chinese medicinal herb frequently prescribed in formulas intended to invigorate blood circulation. CX also exhibits anti-glioma activity, but its molecular mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Methods: In this study, we combined transcriptomics and Raman spectroscopy to investigate the effects of reconstituted CX-dispensing granules (hereafter referred to as CXG solution) on U87MG cells, suggesting their dual role in promoting cell death and modulating collagen deposition and lipid metabolism. Results: Mechanistically, we demonstrated that the CXG solution downregulates hsa-miR-10a-5p, which directly targets BCL2L11, known to induce pro-apoptotic effects, as validated by qPCR and dual-luciferase reporter assays. Furthermore, the CXG solution and hsa-miR-10a-5p suppress lipid metabolism through a coherent feed-forward loop via targeting transcription factors SREBF1 and E2F1. An electrophoretic mobility shift assay (EMSA) confirmed E2F1 binds to the hsa-miR-29a promoter, leading to the synergistic repression of hsa-miR-29a-3p by SREBF1 and E2F1. Network pharmacology analysis combined with molecular docking suggested that the ferulic acid and adenosine in CX potentially modulate EGFR-the E2F1-hsa-miR-10a-5p axis. Conclusions: These findings elucidate CX's multi-target anti-GBM mechanisms and propose a novel therapeutic strategy combining metabolic intervention with miRNA-targeted therapy, providing novel insights into feed-forward loop regulation in miRNA networks.
abstract_zh: 背景/目的：胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是最具侵袭性的原发性恶性脑肿瘤，预后极差且治疗选择有限。川芎（Ligusticum chuanxiong Hort.）的干燥根茎（Chuanxiong, CX）是一种传统中药，常用于活血化瘀的方剂中。CX也表现出抗胶质瘤活性，但其分子机制尚未完全阐明。方法：在本研究中，我们结合转录组学和拉曼光谱技术，探讨了复方川芎配方颗粒（以下简称CXG溶液）对U87MG细胞的影响，提示其在促进细胞死亡和调节胶原沉积及脂质代谢方面具有双重作用。结果：在机制上，我们证明CXG溶液下调hsa-miR-10a-5p，该miRNA直接靶向BCL2L11（已知可诱导促凋亡效应），并通过qPCR和双荧光素酶报告基因实验验证。此外，CXG溶液和hsa-miR-10a-5p通过靶向转录因子SREBF1和E2F1，经由一致的前馈环路抑制脂质代谢。电泳迁移率变动分析（EMSA）证实E2F1结合至hsa-miR-29a启动子，导致SREBF1和E2F1协同抑制hsa-miR-29a-3p。网络药理学分析结合分子对接提示，CX中的阿魏酸和腺苷可能调节EGFR-E2F1-hsa-miR-10a-5p轴。结论：这些发现阐明了CX的多靶点抗GBM机制，并提出了一种结合代谢干预与miRNA靶向治疗的新型治疗策略，为miRNA网络中的前馈环路调控提供了新见解。
